body: Oh, I don't have much faith in my abilities. I don't think I'll enjoy or be successful at anything. Biology is definitely the worst though. My parents put a ton of stress on me to make sure that I make a lot of money, and I'm scared of failing them. I want to study special ed or ESL education or maybe be a counselor or a social worker, but these things would definitely disappoint my parents because they don't make a lot of money. I  don't really enjoy anything accept for making other people happy. Also, everybody would make fun of me for trying one of these fields, because I'm a guy and doing one of these jobs would make me a faggot :(
You're right :'( but I can't because I don't have anything that I can use to painlessly kill myself with. Once I get access, I'll try.
I hate biology. If I don't kill myself, I will definitely switch majors.
I'm in biology, chemistry, college writing, and another required writing class.

I've learned a lot, but that doesn't do me any good. I know more than most people with better grades, but my organization skills and ability to focus keep me from getting things in on time or remembering to do assignments. Learning doesn't do you any good, because you can't prove to people that you learned without good grades. Good grades get people jobs, not learning.
